instruction: When I reply to emails, I prefer to write my response at the bottom of the original message. Can you help me change Thunderbird settings to place my reply below the quoted text instead of above it?

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing reply position to below quoted text in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks prefs.js for mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top set to 0 (reply below). Verified in sample prefs.js that this setting exists with value 1 (reply on top), so task requires changing it to 0. Similar complexity to original task.
metadata.verification: Verified in sample prefs.js that mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top is currently set to 1 (reply above). Task requires changing it to 0 to place replies below quoted text.

Expected value is semantically correct: reply_on_top=0 means reply below (as verified in metadata)

Edge cases handled: None values return 0.0 score, postconfig ensures preferences are saved to disk
